note: Fixed rule -> (severity, enforcement location, waivable) contract. Severity is a function of the rule, never chosen per edge instance. `waivable` is true iff severity is WARN. ACYCLIC is ERROR and therefore not waivable: an ERROR cycle can never be acknowledged into a DAG.

rules.statement: No transitive ancestor relation may be re-declared as a direct edge. Violations are acknowledged with a reason and by an authenticated principal.
The steps+edges graph must be acyclic. A violation is rejected at both authoring reconciliation and run pre-flight, and rejects dispatch. There is no waiver arm.
